newsitem.title: UK: W. Europe markets report nearby cotton interest.
newsitem.headline: W. Europe markets report nearby cotton interest.

text.p: Several markets in western Europe reported sustained enquiry for nearby cotton, industry sources said.
Moderate business was believed to have been arranged in such growths as Central Asian, West African, Syrian and Spanish.
The level of demand in eastern Europe was difficult to identify though a latent buying interest was noted for medium staple American type descriptions together with some long staple varieties.
